pages.title: The three nursery techniques
pages.text:
To produce your seedlings, three techniques are commonly used:

1. Growing the seedlings in an **in-ground nursery**.
2. Growing the seedlings in a **container-based (off-ground) nursery**.
3. **Pricking out the seedlings into pots** before transplanting them.

Each method has its advantages and disadvantages. We will show you how to choose according to your needs.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Les trois techniques de pépinière

pages.title: 1. The in-ground starter nursery
pages.text: Discover the principle, the advantages and the limits of the in-ground nursery.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour 1. La pépinière de démarrage pleine terre

pages.title: What is an in-ground starter nursery?
pages.text: Seeds are sown **directly into prepared soil**. The young seedlings grow there before being transplanted onto the cultivation beds.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Qu’est-ce qu’une pépinière de démarrage pleine terre ?

pages.title: Advantages and disadvantages of the in-ground nursery
pages.text:
**Advantages:**

- Simple and quick to set up.
- Requires little equipment.

**Disadvantages:**

- Fragile roots at transplanting.
- Faster risk of drying out.
- Susceptibility to soil-borne diseases.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Avantages et inconvénients de la pépinière pleine terre

pages.title: 2. The container-based starter nursery
pages.text: Discover the principle, the required equipment, the advantages and the limits of the container-based nursery.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour 2. La pépinière de démarrage hors-sol

pages.title: What is a container-based starter nursery?
pages.text: Seeds are sown in **containers** before the seedlings are transplanted: crates, jerry cans, trays. These containers are filled with **potting mix**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Qu’est-ce qu’une pépinière de démarrage hors-sol ?

pages.title: Equipment needed for the container-based nursery
pages.text:
To set up a container-based starter nursery, you will need the following equipment:

- A **quality potting mix**.
- A **protective insect net**.
- **Sand or gravel** to ensure drainage.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Matériel nécessaire pour la pépinière hors-sol

pages.title: Advantages and disadvantages of the container-based nursery
pages.text:
**Advantages:**

- Better control of the roots.
- A nursery that is easy to move.

**Disadvantages:**

- More frequent watering.
- Requires additional equipment.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Avantages et inconvénients de la pépinière hors-sol

pages.title: 3. The nursery followed by pricking out
pages.text: Discover how pricking out into pots strengthens your seedlings before they are transplanted into the field.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour 3. La pépinière suivie d’un repiquage

pages.title: What is pricking out?
pages.text:
Young seedlings are first raised in the ground or in containers, then **pricked out into pots** before final transplanting.

This is the technique usually used for **fruit tree** and **fruiting vegetable** nurseries.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Qu’est-ce que le repiquage ?

pages.title: Equipment needed for pricking out
pages.text:
To prick out your seedlings, you will need the following equipment:

- **Pots** or **plastic bags**.
- A **nutrient-rich potting mix**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Matériel nécessaire pour le repiquage

pages.title: Advantages and disadvantages of pricking out
pages.text:
**Advantages:**

- Stronger roots.
- Better recovery after transplanting.
- Less time spent in the field.
- Reduced water requirement.

**Disadvantages:**

- Additional work.
- Risk of stress if the seedling is poorly pricked out.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Avantages et inconvénients du repiquage

pages.title: Conclusion: choosing the right technique
pages.text: Choose your nursery technique (**in-ground**, **container-based** or **followed by pricking out**) according to your resources, your crops and your goals.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Conclusion : choisir la technique adaptée
